query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT id FROM changesets WHERE COALESCE(project_id = $1, $1 IS NULL) AND COALESCE(status = $2, $2 IS NULL) AND (NOT $3 OR agent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $4) AND (NOT $5 OR workflow_run_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $6) AND (id < $8) AND ($8 IS NOT NULL) AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $7) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM changesets WHERE COALESCE(project_id = $1, $1 IS NULL) AND COALESCE(status = $2, $2 IS NULL) AND (NOT $3 OR agent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $4) AND (NOT $5 OR workflow_run_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $6) AND ($8 IS NULL) AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $7) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $7) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $9 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN changeset_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.id desc, i.id, e.sequence
